title: neyraudia arundinacea var. zollingeri
intro: Neyraudia arundinacea var. zollingeri, commonly known as Zollinger's Neyraudia, is a type of bamboo grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including its ability to help lower blood pressure, alleviate inflammation, and support respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Zollinger's Neyraudia include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its traditional uses in treating coughs, colds, and other respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
